name: Mini Craft Scissors
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted with durable stainless steel blades, these mini scissors deliver precise, clean cuts every time. 
  • The sturdy spring mechanism ensures smooth opening and closing, while the protective faux leather cover keeps the blades safe and adds a touch of elegance. 
  • Soft plastic handles provide a comfortable grip for extended use.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:
  • Designed for portability, the scissors measure approximately 1.6 in (4.2 cm) in length, making them ultra-compact and easy to carry. 
  • The leather cover is about 1.1 in x 0.98 in (2.8 cm x 2.5 cm), and the tassel adds a stylish accent at around 2.1 in (5.5 cm). 
  • The included box measures 2.36 in x 2.36 in (6 cm x 6 cm)

 

Printing Technology:
  • Personalization is brought to life with high-quality UV printing that ensures vibrant colors and crisp details. Your custom name or design is applied with precision, resulting in a long-lasting finish that won’t easily fade or peel.
  • This product is printed on one side only.

 

Functionality Use:
  • These mini scissors are ideal for cutting thread, yarn, paper, and other lightweight materials. Perfect for sewing kits, embroidery, knitting, crafting, or even quick everyday fixes. 
  • The protective cover and compact size make them easy to carry in your bag, pencil case, or travel kit.
 
Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

Stylish, practical, and customizable, these mini craft scissors make a thoughtful gift for crafters, DIY lovers, students, or anyone who appreciates handy tools. Great for birthdays, holidays, Mother’s Day, or as a unique personalized keepsake.

 

Specification
  • Processing Time: 5-7 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Mini Craft Scissors

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
